mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC drops below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and capital expenditure, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND CPIAUCSL falls > 0.5% monthly
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings and capital expenditure, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04.
